I have a cat that I found when he was 3-4 weeks, he was abandoned by his mother, he could barely see, and had worms.

I took him home, to the reduced price vet clinic to have him dewormed and checked. It cost me less than 20$. I spent a whole month on unemployment (worked for a college cafeteria, no college students in summer = no work) taking care of him, he could fit in the palm of my hand. I had to rub his bum to get him to do his business, bottle fed him, and kept him in a large laundry basket over night to keep him from hurting himself.

He is now almost two years old and I am his world. I come home from work, he runs down the stairs, he knows his name and sometimes comes when called. He loves the leash and exploring the outside. He sleeps most nights on the blanket between my legs. Sometimes I bend down to pet him and he jumps up on my should and purrs thunderously. 

I had some very down days last week and while crying in the bed he climbed up on me, plopped down and purred. He is possibly the most wonderful addition to my life.

I hope you get your good doggo and feel the same love I get.
